# Division of Bone and Mineral Diseases | Washington University in St. Louis

> > A comprehensive clinical and research division dedicated to bone health, osteoporosis treatment, and mineral disease management at Washington University School of Medicine.

The Division of Bone and Mineral Diseases at Washington University in St. Louis provides specialized patient care, clinical research, and education in bone health and metabolic disorders. The division operates the WashU Bone Health Program with multiple clinic locations and offers advanced diagnostic services including DXA bone density testing.

## Patient Care & Clinical Services

- [Patient Care](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/patient-care): WashU Bone Health Program patient care services and clinical offerings overview
- [Planning Your Visit](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/patient-care/planning-your-visit): Guide to visit preparation including insurance, referrals, and appointment scheduling
- [Clinic Locations](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/patient-care/locations): Clinic locations including Center for Advanced Medicine and West County Hospital
- [Bone Health Specialists](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/patient-care/bone-health-physicians): Directory of bone health specialist physicians and clinical experts at WashU
- [Bone Health Staff](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/patient-care/bone-health-staff): Bone Health Program staff including ISCD-certified densitometry technologists

## Diagnostic Testing & Bone Health Education

- [Bone Density/DXA Testing](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/patient-care/dxa-testing): Guide to DXA bone density testing, screening procedures and fracture risk assessment
- [Osteopenia and Osteoporosis](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/patient-care/facts-about-osteoporosis): Patient education on osteoporosis and osteopenia definitions, risk factors and treatment
- [Calcium & Vitamin D](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/patient-care/facts-about-osteoporosis/about-calcium-vitamin-d): Nutritional guidelines for calcium and vitamin D supplementation for bone health
- [Exercise & Bone Health](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/patient-care/facts-about-osteoporosis/exercise-and-bone-health): Exercise guide for bone health including weight-bearing and muscle strengthening activities
- [Fall Prevention and Safety Tips](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/patient-care/facts-about-osteoporosis/fall-prevention): Fall prevention strategies and home safety tips for osteoporosis patients
- [Osteoporosis Medications](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/patient-care/facts-about-osteoporosis/osteoporosis-medications): Patient guide to osteoporosis medications including bisphosphonates and treatment options

- [Home](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu): Homepage for WashU Division of Bone and Mineral Diseases with clinical research and patient care overview

## Division History & Legacy

- [History](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/about-us/our-history): Historical overview of Division founded by Louis V. Avioli and research legacy

- [Decade of Growth](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/about-us/our-history/decade-of-growth): Division institutional growth and clinical program expansion in osteoporosis research
- [New Century](https://bonehealth.wustl.edu/about-us/our-history/new-century): Division leadership transitions and clinical expansion in new century
